evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints.
